source_evidence: allows you to find out if your investment professional is licensed and registered, and if the firm or person (registered representative) has had run-ins with regulators or received complaints from investors.
question: Misconception: If a broker is registered, that means they have no disciplinary history or investor complaints.
answer: Registration and disciplinary history are separate things to check. A search can show whether a professional is licensed and registered, as well as whether the person or firm has had run-ins with regulators or received investor complaints. Check both the broker and the firm.
